remarks: Attention Contractors, Investors or Homebuyers who see the potential in this 2-family house. Sold as-is. No representation of heating or plumbing to be in working order. Private driveway with detached garage. Nice-sized backyard perfect for summer barbecues and outdoor entertaining.  Ideal for investors or owner-occupants seeking rental potential in a prime Stamford location, close to I-95, Stamford Hospital, just minutes from downtown Stamford, train stations, parks, shopping and restaurants. Please execute the Hold Harmless Form prior to scheduling an appointment.
